🇷🇺 Gazprom launches 110 MW turbine in Yakutia A 110 MW gas turbine unit has been commissioned at the South Yakutskaya Thermal Power Plant in Chulman, Neryungri district. The station is being built from scratch under harsh climatic conditions and receives fuel via the "Power of Siberia" pipeline. Energy Minister Sergey Tsivilev, Gazprom CEO Alexey Miller, and Yakutia Head Aisen Nikolaev attended the event. Upon full development, the plant will reach 313 MW with two 110 MW gas turbines and one 93 MW steam turbine. The new capacity will supply Russia's Eastern energy system, primarily for electrifying the RZD Eastern Polygon railway. @Slavyangrad
